name: godot-cli
description: Use a local, authenticated CLI to inspect and safely control an open Godot 4.6 editor.

shortDescription.en-US: Safely operate an open Godot 4.6 editor through a local CLI.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 通过本地 CLI 安全操作已打开的 Godot 4.6 编辑器。

longDescription.en-US: A skill-only, Windows x86_64 plugin that bundles the Godot CLI editor addon and Rust executable. It uses authenticated loopback communication, defaults to read-only operations, and requires explicit approval for every editor write. It does not add MCP, HTTP services, or another runtime.
longDescription.zh-CN: 仅包含 Skill 的 Windows x86_64 插件，随包提供 Godot CLI 编辑器插件与 Rust 可执行文件。它使用经过认证的环回通信，默认只读，每次编辑器写入都必须明确确认；不引入 MCP、HTTP 服务或额外运行时。
